# Introduction

This Trial Specifications Document (TSD) describes the design and technical details of the Management Strategy Evaluation (MSE) of North Pacific swordfish (*Xiphias gladius*; NSWO), including the operating models, candidate management procedures, and performance metrics used to evaluate them.

The TSD is a **living document** that will be updated as the MSE progresses to reflect the current state of the analysis.

For more information on the North Pacific Swordfish MSE process see the project [homepage](https://wcpfcnswo.bluematterscience.com/).

## About the NSWO MSE

The NSWO MSE is built and maintained by [Blue Matter Science](https://bluematterscience.com) using the [openMSE](https://openMSE.com) framework.

The analysis is fully reproducible, and all materials are available in the associated [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Blue-Matter/wcpfcNSWO).
